correctness.rationale: The P10 family has exactly 16 maximal independent sets, fully re-enumerated by an independent domination predicate. Vertex-membership counts (9,7,5,8,6,6,8,5,7,9) leave only two balanced coordinates, which forbids static shattering of four coordinates; a supplied three-coordinate certificate attains three. The supplied complete depth-four tree has 16 distinct valid leaf witnesses, and cardinality 16 forbids depth five. For m disconnected blocks, maximal independent sets factor exactly; static shattering is componentwise; sequentially concatenated depth-four trees supply depth 4m, while cardinality 16^m gives the upper bound. Degree-one graphs are independent edges and isolates. An executable checker validates every small certificate and path orders 1..10.

value.rationale: The first path exhibiting an exact VC/Littlestone separation yields, by a valid independent-component construction, a linear unbounded gap for all numbers of blocks. This locates a sharp maximum-degree boundary for forests: equality at maximum degree at most one but divergence at degree two. The structural boundary is an invariant statement about a natural online independent-domination query problem, and the infinite conclusion is not merely a small isolated census.
